name: Greenworks 40V 20-Inch Cordless Dual-Blade Push Lawn Mower (Model 25302) - Tool Only
description: Selling a Greenworks 40V 20-Inch Cordless Twin Force Dual-Blade Push Lawn Mower (Model 25302) [Greenworks Tools](https://greenworkstools.com). Please note: This is the **TOOL ONLY** listing—it does NOT come with a 40V battery or charger. This is absolutely perfect if you already own Greenworks 40V G-MAX ecosystem tools (like a string trimmer or leaf blower) and just need a high-performance backup or replacement deck. Features a 20-inch cutting width with a dual-blade system, automatic dual-battery switching port, and a single-lever 5-position height adjustment. Includes the rear grass collection bag. The unit comes fully pre-assembled, saving you from any tedious out-of-the-box construction setup. Used outdoors and stored on a covered porch; expect minor aesthetic cosmetic scuffs from normal yard-work utility. Does NOT come with secondary retail storage packaging covers or bags, so please prep your vehicle's trunk space for local pickup.
contact_note: TOOL ONLY—No battery or charger included. Fully pre-assembled with a collapsible handle design. Folds completely flat to fit inside a standard sedan backseat or SUV cargo space. Pick up directly from the patio porch area.

name_zh: Greenworks 绿霸 40V 20寸无线双刀片割草机 (仅机身 Tool-Only)
